stages.reconstruct: θ₀=35−90=−55°. First reflection θ₁=2φ+55°. Second θ₂=160−(2φ+55)=105−2φ. Set θ₂≡270 (mod 360), so 2φ≡195 (mod 360), φ≡97.5° (mod 180). Check θ₁=250°, θ₂=−90°≡270°. Actual segment interception and reflecting side must be checked separately.
